checks: Heliocentric source-minus-lens NE trajectory and unresolved image-summed centroid signs remain consistent with v1 independent derivation.
G1 preserves each native marginal variance; G2 calibration scale/floor are explicit fitted hypotheses and never edits supplied errors.
Full Gaussian objective includes negative relative log determinants and fixed least-squares offset is subtracted from reported deviance.
Independent dense checks include duplicate epochs, f=0,.2,.95 and native/calibrated/worst-bound scales.
Numerical time center is separated from physical time domain and target-specific bounds/initial guesses required for unknown targets.
Brightness diagnostic uses noise-free model predictions, avoiding selection on noisy residuals.
Complete candidate set, named diagnostics, blocked-night predictive rule, fixed control seeds, sensitivity set, and stop-if-all-fail rule are written before measured v2 fits.
Portable importer uses PureWindowsPath for archived provenance basename and verified exact source pack.
qualifications: Review approves the prospective calculation, not adequacy of any measured-data outcome or astrophysical classification.
Single noisy-seed controls and 20 later parametric controls do not certify frequentist coverage; 20 controls have only 1/21 coarse tail resolution.
Both scalar chi-square tails and residual structure/prediction gates must remain visible; no passing scalar fit overrides failed bins or lag diagnostics.
Held-out driver was not yet implemented: evaluate all-minus-training conditional Q and relative log determinant at training-only fitted parameters, preserving training nuisance state.
Native HJD underlying clock and precise combined HST centroid epochs remain qualified; mandatory time-window and clock sensitivities are required.
Physical nuisance boundaries are nonregular; numerical caps, unresolved minima and incomplete competing modes prevent interval eligibility.
A conditional mass point is not a BH identification. Adequate angular/parallax profiles, sensitivity robustness and independent darkness/single-lens evidence are separate requirements.
G2 is a post-v1-diagnostic prospective calibration hypothesis, not external preregistration and not permission for further outcome-driven model iteration.
